limitations.quote: The fix registers the conjunction of both checks on the incoming nine-bit window, including the bit sampled at that edge.
limitations.note: The rewrite aligned the two checks but advanced detection by one clock relative to the correct fix, which checks the pre-shift window, and added a sample counter that suppresses matches involving reset-initialized bits.

The testbench computed its expected result from the just-shifted history and enforced the same nine-sample gate as the rewrite, so passing confirmed the agent's assumptions rather than the required timing and post-reset behavior.

limitations.quote: # Duplicate state encoding in a Moore FSM
limitations.note: The only knowledge-base entry concerned duplicate FSM state encodings and offered no guidance on which shift-register window the detector should check.
